## Personality

Joseph is a timid child who is noticeably prone to blushing and stuttering whenever he becomes frightened.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P11](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0011)_

## History

Joseph was one of Anne's students during her teaching job. He was among the pupils whose classroom compositions and amusing stories were highlighted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a letter she wrote to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
